comments: cb555372: This program is used for deleting patient incomplete records.
819d8363: Entry point for the program.
53d4647a: Check if division selection is enabled in the system parameters and prompt for division if it is.
feaf2e0e: If no division has been selected, default to the first division in the file.
6efbb0b5: Display a message if the parameters for delinquency tracking are not set up for the division.
b67bf5f2: Screen incomplete records to those belonging to the selected division.
c6eb13dd: Prompt user to select a patient incomplete record to delete.
0225caea: Prepare for viewing the selected patient record before deletion.
2901b93c: Initialize variables for the OK to Delete process.
d6e048bd: Clear the return value for the ListMan screen.
1476a057: Select records from the list to process for deletion.
db654961: Ensure the full screen mode is activated and set the screen to return to after processing.
5191592e: For each selected record, prepare and perform the deletion process.
8f2d8633: Return to the report screen after processing.
5fd4514d: Prompt for confirmation before actually deleting the record.
5cf47e51: If confirmed, delete the selected patient incomplete record.
fe861dac: Exit the deletion process if the user chooses not to delete.
1aca1fcc: Set a flag to indicate the user has exited the process.
2fd1b1c9: Cleanup variables and exit the routine.
6f4260ce: Provide instructions for the Yes/No prompt.
